title: Bleach Announces February 2027 Celebration After Anime Finale
excerpt:
A new visual previews a major gathering of cast and production talent.
No new anime continuation has been confirmed.
body_md:
Bleach is preparing a special farewell celebration following the conclusion of its Thousand-Year Blood War television adaptation. Bleach Fes. is scheduled for February 27–28, 2027, in Japan, with voice actors and members of the production team expected to revisit the franchise's long journey. A newly revealed promotional image highlights familiar characters ahead of the gathering.

The event arrives after the anime's final arc brought Ichigo Kurosaki's battle against Yhwach to its conclusion. The story's closing time jump also introduced Kazui, Ichigo and Orihime's son, offering a glimpse of the characters' lives beyond the central conflict. The celebration is intended as a look back at the anime's legacy rather than an announced new season.

Fans still have reasons to speculate about what could come next. Creator Tite Kubo previously revisited the manga's world in the No Breathes From Hell one-shot, opening intriguing possibilities involving the realm of Hell. However, neither an animated adaptation of that material nor a broader continuation has been officially announced. International plans for Bleach Fes. also remain unconfirmed.
